build_accuracy_metric: build a python module to calculate classification accuracy using the Accuracy metric class with configurable topk
build_vqa_accuracy_metric: build a python module to calculate VQA accuracy using the VQAAccuracy metric class with masked softmax
build_recall_at_k_metric: build a python module to calculate Recall@1, Recall@5, or Recall@10 using the RecallAtK base class
build_f1_metric: build a python module to calculate F1 score using the F1 metric class with multilabel and averaging options
build_retrieval_recall_metric: build a python module to calculate image-text retrieval recall using the RecallAtK_ret class with flip support
